description: This file contains unit tests for the Config class within the Goteo application's testing namespace. It tests configuration instance creation, YAML language file validation, environment variable substitution in config, and environment variable-related config retrieval.

classes.name: ConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Goteo Application Config functionality using PHPUnit.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Config class and asserts its type.

methods.name: testValidateYamlLangFiles
methods.description: Validates that language YAML files are valid arrays by parsing them.

methods.name: testShallowEnvSubstitution
methods.description: Tests shallow environment variable substitution in config parameters.

methods.name: testDeepEnvSubstitution
methods.description: Tests deep/nested environment variable substitution, including nested arrays.

methods.name: testYamlLangFilesWithEnvParameter
methods.description: Verifies environment variable retrieval within YAML language files, specifically for database port.

methods.name: testYamlLangFilesWithEnvParameterInArrays
methods.description: Verifies environment variable retrieval within array values in YAML configs.
